## `client.repositories`

The `repositories` resource of the platform API.

### `client.repositories.create`

Signature: `client.repositories.create(name: str, kind: str, url: str, *, credential_secret: str | None = None, credential_username: str | None = None, ssh_known_hosts: str | None = None, default_ref: str | None = None) -> Repository`

Register a repository (needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | Unique name; no dots. |
| `kind` | `str` | required | ``local``, ``https`` or ``ssh``. |
| `url` | `str` | required | URL, or an absolute path for ``local``. |
| `credential_secret` | `str | None` | `None` | Secret name resolved per environment. |
| `credential_username` | `str | None` | `None` | HTTPS username; default ``oauth2``. |
| `ssh_known_hosts` | `str | None` | `None` | Required for ``ssh``. |
| `default_ref` | `str | None` | `None` | Ref deployed when none is given. |

Returns: `Repository`. The registered repository.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the name is taken. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If a field is invalid. |

### `client.repositories.deploy_key`

Signature: `client.repositories.deploy_key(name: str, *, secret: str | None = None, environments: Sequence[str] | None = None, replace: bool = False) -> DeployKeys`

Make an SSH deploy key for each environment; the server keeps the private halves.

Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` and `MANAGE_SECRET` in each environment written, and an ssh repository with confirmed host keys. By default every environment you may manage secrets in that has no key yet gets one; add each public key at your git host as a read-only deploy key.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The repository's name. |
| `secret` | `str | None` | `None` | The secret name; ``&lt;name&gt;-deploy-key`` by default. |
| `environments` | `Sequence[str] | None` | `None` | Only these environments. |
| `replace` | `bool` | `False` | Replace the keys of `environments` (required with it); the old keys stop working. |

Returns: `DeployKeys`. The public keys, by environment.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | For a repository that is not ssh or has no host keys, or `replace` alone. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If a secret of the name is revoked or is not a key made for this repository. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | Without the rights above. |
| `lakana.InvalidResponse` | If the answer is not a deploy key answer. |

### `client.repositories.host_keys`

Signature: `client.repositories.host_keys(url: str, *, wait: bool = True, timeout: float = 60.0, on_update: Callable[[RepositoryProbe], None] | None = None) -> RepositoryProbe`

Fetch the SSH host keys of a repository URL's host; a worker connects, not the server.

Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY`. Compare each key's `fingerprint` with your git host's published fingerprints before you put its `line` into `ssh_known_hosts`.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | `str` | required | An SSH repository URL (``git@host:path`` or ``ssh://…``). |
| `wait` | `bool` | `True` | Poll until the check is done; `False` returns it as queued. |
| `timeout` | `float` | `60.0` | Seconds to keep polling. |
| `on_update` | `Callable[[RepositoryProbe], None] | None` | `None` | Called with the check after each poll that found it not done yet. |

Returns: `RepositoryProbe`. The check; with its `host_keys` once done ``ok``.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If the URL is not a safe SSH URL. |
| `lakana.ServerError` | With status 503 when no worker that takes pipeline work is running. |
| `TimeoutError` | If the check is not done after `timeout` seconds. |

### `client.repositories.test_access`

Signature: `client.repositories.test_access(name: str, environment: str, *, wait: bool = True, timeout: float = 120.0, on_update: Callable[[RepositoryProbe], None] | None = None) -> RepositoryProbe`

Test that a worker can read a repository with an environment's credential.

Needs `MANAGE_REPOSITORY` and `READ_ENVIRONMENT` on the environment. The worker runs `git ls-remote` with the repository's own known hosts; nothing is fetched.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | The repository's name. |
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment whose secret of the repository's credential is used. |
| `wait` | `bool` | `True` | Poll until the check is done; `False` returns it as queued. |
| `timeout` | `float` | `120.0` | Seconds to keep polling. |
| `on_update` | `Callable[[RepositoryProbe], None] | None` | `None` | Called with the check after each poll that found it not done yet. |

Returns: `RepositoryProbe`. The check.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the repository or the environment does not exist. |
| `TimeoutError` | If the check is not done after `timeout` seconds. |
